title: Apply amount adjustments in the stated business sequence
covers: T-ORDER (calculation sequence, clamping, excess not consumed)

facts.note: Role (PLT-84), mapped to paths by the structure profile.
The task states a sequence between amount adjustments or a floor.
Diff edits a multi-step amount computation.

fires: A new deduction must be applied after one adjustment and before a derived charge.
A deduction may exceed the remaining amount.
doesNotFire: A single fixed amount with no adjustments.

given: An amount is computed from several adjustments whose sequence or floor the requirement states
when: the agent adds or changes one of those adjustments
then: Apply the adjustments in the stated sequence, each to the result of the previous step, and compute derived charges on the final adjusted base.
prefer: One function that applies the steps in sequence and returns every intermediate value the caller must report.
Clamp at the stated floor and apply (and consume from its source) only the part of a deduction actually used.
A test per boundary: deduction larger than the remaining amount, and a derived charge whose rounding changes because of the deduction.
avoid: Computing a derived charge on the pre-deduction base and subtracting afterwards.
Duplicating the step sequence in two places (for example a quote path and an apply path).
why: The sequence of adjustments changes the result; mistakes pass simple tests and surface only on boundary amounts.
evidence: Tests cover the stated sequence, the floor and an over-sized deduction.
Only one code path defines the sequence.
